$comment: B05, a batch of stage E71 (line A, claude/e71-a), with E25's content part: each text written from the facts of the functions that run its rule (O6, M1), the English by one agent, the Polish by another from the facts, the code and the old Polish without the new English (DB26), then read by the EN, cold EN, PL and (rules batches) mechanics reviewers and revised once; `reviews` holds what each reviewer still holds open after that revision, `owner` is null (no owner's page yet). Written on claude/e71-a 14.11.2026; the afters are the text of lang/ and config.mjs from the commit that adds this file.

A critical Finishing Blow names its striker in the incident state, and that striker's first clean-up attempt that reaches its price, hit or miss, costs no Sanity (consumeFreeCleanup).

en.after: Each attempt costs {n} Sanity, hit or miss; the first after a critical Finishing Blow costs none.

Parity (M4, F0-F2): the Polish carries the Body roll, the tool, the miss, the bedroom and the two-rooms-away critical, the English after only the Evident Remnant; the Polish stays, the English is the side that drops kept facts. - executor: Taken in part: the English now names the Body roll; the Polish is cut to R3201's length (under 114 characters, it was about 240), and the bedroom, the miss and the two-rooms-away critical are in DRPG.Cleanup.moveAlwaysTrace and DRPG.Cleanup.moveFar in both languages (O3).

facts.fact: Outcomes (CLEANUP.outcome): a critical or a hit with Hope erases and leaves nothing; a hit with Despair erases and leaves an Evident Faint Tamper Remnant; a miss leaves the Remnant and a Faint Tamper Remnant, Subtle with Hope, Evident with Despair; a critical gives back 1 of the step paid.
resolveTransformRoad reports with the same band, so a reshape that hits with Despair shows this line, though nothing is erased and no Tamper Remnant is left on that road.

disagreements: The old text said "Gone" on every hit with Despair; on the reshape road nothing is erased (resolveTransformRoad shares the band line). For the owner: one band line serves both roads.

points: Understood only that the Remnant is gone with a cost hidden in 'not careful'; the card does not say what the carelessness left behind or changes, so a player cannot tell the consequence of the Despair (O1, O7) (proposed: name the consequence, e.g. 'Gone, but with Despair: <what it costs or leaves>.'). - executor: Kept in part: the line now says only that it worked, not cleanly, which is true on both roads; what the carelessness leaves on the erase road (a Faint Tamper Remnant) the player is told only with Hope or on a critical (leaveTamperTrace, traceFeedback), so naming it here would tell a player what they may not know (M9).

pl.before: {from} czyta się teraz jako „{name}” - {band} {kind}. Kto to znajdzie, znajdzie twoją historię, nie to, co tu było.
pl.after: GM zatwierdza zmianę: {from} to teraz „{name}” ({band} {kind}). Kto go znajdzie, zobaczy twoją wersję.

removed: "not what was there" goes (X3).
disagreements: For the owner: {from} is the ledger's band and type, which a player off Stage 6 is otherwise not shown (cleanableTracesForPlayer names it by the player's copy); the text keeps what the code sends.

facts.fact: A reshape's words go to the GMs as a card; nothing is written on the Remnant until a GM approves; a refusal keeps the price spent.
An approved reshape becomes a Tamper Remnant (CLEANUP.transformAction.becomes); a critical writes one band quieter and gives back 1 of the step paid.

en.before: A GM approves your words first, and a refusal gives back nothing you paid. Approved, it becomes a Tamper Remnant, which admits that somebody handled it and lies about everything else. A critical also makes it one band quieter and hands back what you paid.
en.after: A GM approves your words first, and a refusal gives nothing back. Once approved, it becomes a Tamper Remnant. A critical also makes it one band harder to spot and gives back what you paid.

pl.before: Najpierw twoje słowa zatwierdza GM, a po odmowie nic, co zapłacono, nie wraca. Po zatwierdzeniu Remnant staje się Tamper Remnant, który przyznaje, że ktoś przy nim majstrował, i kłamie o całej reszcie. Krytyk dodatkowo wycisza go o jeden stopień i zwraca koszt.
pl.after: Twoją wersję najpierw zatwierdza GM, a po odmowie koszt nie wraca. Po zgodzie Remnant staje się Tamper Remnant; krytyk sprawia też, że o stopień trudniej go zauważyć, i zwraca ci koszt.

removed: "which admits that somebody handled it and lies about everything else" goes: rationale (O9).
Tier 1 R121 holds the Reshape's sentences to a refusal that gives nothing back (pl /odmow...nie wraca|przepada/): the Polish after says „po odmowie koszt nie wraca” after the first tier 1 run.

points: EN grammar: "if refused, what you paid stays spent" is a dangling modifier (it is the words that are refused, not what you paid) (proposed: A GM approves your words first; if the GM refuses, what you paid stays spent. Once approved, it becomes a Tamper Remnant. A critical also makes it one band harder to spot and gives back what you paid.). - executor: Taken in part: the dangling "if refused" goes, but not for "what you paid stays spent": a critical's hand-back runs before the ruling (resolveTransformRoad), so the text says the refusal gives nothing back.

facts.fact: The button returns the words and attemptCleanup rolls next.

en.before: Reshape it
en.after: Roll

pl.before: Przerób
pl.after: Rzuć

removed: "Reshape it" becomes "Roll", E100's word for an action window's button that rolls; the window's title names the action.

facts.fact: Asked after a critical on the erase road: erase, or propose a reshape with a band of the player's choice.

en.before: You have time to do more than wipe it. Erase the Remnant, or leave it saying something else entirely - and, this well rolled, choose how loudly it says it.
en.after: Your critical lets you do more than erase this Remnant: erase it, or give it a new name and description and choose how easy it is to spot.

pl.before: Masz czas na więcej niż wytarcie. Usuń Remnant albo zostaw go mówiącego coś zupełnie innego - a przy tak dobrym rzucie wybierz, jak głośno to mówi.
pl.after: Krytyk daje ci wybór: wymaż Remnant albo zaproponuj jego nową wersję i wybierz, jak łatwo będzie go zauważyć.

removed: The dash aside (X4) goes.

facts.fact: A refused reshape on the erase road still erases; the critical's give-back already happened when the dice landed.

en.before: Nobody sees you decide. Erasing happens now. Leaving something else waits for a GM's approval first: whoever finds it then finds your story, as a Tamper Remnant. If the GM refuses, the Remnant is erased all the same and nothing you paid comes back.
en.after: Erasing happens now. A new story waits for a GM's approval, and then the Remnant becomes a Tamper Remnant with your words. If the GM refuses, the Remnant is erased anyway and nothing else you paid comes back.

pl.before: Nikt nie widzi, jak decydujesz. Usunięcie działa od razu. Zostawienie czegoś innego najpierw zatwierdza GM: kto potem znajdzie ten Remnant, znajdzie twoją wersję jako Tamper Remnant. Po odmowie GM-a Remnant i tak znika, a to, co zapłacono, nie wraca.
pl.after: Wymazanie działa od razu. Nową wersję najpierw zatwierdza GM, a po zgodzie Remnant staje się Tamper Remnant; po odmowie Remnant i tak znika, a reszta kosztu nie wraca.

removed: "Nobody sees you decide" goes (O10).
"nothing you paid comes back" goes: the critical already gave back 1 of what was paid.
Tier 1 R121 holds the Reshape's sentences to a refusal that gives nothing back: both afters say what else was paid does not come back, the critical's refund aside, after the first tier 1 run.
disagreements: The old text said nothing paid comes back on a refusal; the critical's give-back (handBack) runs before the ruling, and the refusal takes nothing more.

facts.fact: A Reinforced Remnant cannot be erased or reshaped; an attempt on one is refused before anything is scored and what was paid comes back as far as the GMs saw it paid.
The line is the disabled reason of both the Erase a Trace row and the Reshape a Trace row.

en.before: Every Remnant you know of here is too deeply set to remove.
en.after: Every Remnant you know of here is Reinforced and cannot be erased or reshaped.

pl.before: Każdy Remnant, który tu znasz, siedzi za głęboko, by go usunąć.
pl.after: Każdy Remnant, który tu znasz, jest Reinforced, więc żadnego nie wymażesz ani nie przekształcisz.

removed: "too deeply set" becomes the quality's name (EN18, O14).

facts.fact: A watched attempt is refused when the Sanity track is full.

With anybody but the killer's partners in the room, a Shadow concealment roll against CLEANUP.conceal.threshold comes first (not for Move the Body): a hit with Despair costs 1 Sanity, a miss 1 with Hope and 2 with Despair, a critical gives 1 back; a miss tells the others in the room and the GMs.

en.before: Somebody is watching, and covering what you are doing costs Sanity you no longer have.
en.after: Somebody is watching, and you have no Sanity left to cover what you are doing.

pl.before: Ktoś patrzy, a zamaskowanie tego, co robisz, kosztuje Sanity, którego już nie masz.
pl.after: Ktoś patrzy, a zamaskowanie tego, co robisz, kosztuje Sanity, którego już nie masz.

removed: "Sanity you no longer have" said as the reserve (D5).

facts.fact: With anybody but the killer's partners in the room, a Shadow concealment roll against CLEANUP.conceal.threshold comes first (not for Move the Body): a hit with Despair costs 1 Sanity, a miss 1 with Hope and 2 with Despair, a critical gives 1 back; a miss tells the others in the room and the GMs.
{n} counts the others through witnessesTo, the killer's partners left out; {dc} is CLEANUP.conceal.threshold.
Move the Body, on the same Tamper menu in Stage 6, rolls no concealment (cover is "alone").

before.one: {n} other person is in this room. You cover what you are doing first ({dc}+), and being caught at it costs Sanity.
before.other: {n} other people are in this room. You cover what you are doing first ({dc}+), and being caught at it costs Sanity.

after.one: {n} other person in this room can see you. Unless you Move the Body, you first roll Shadow ({dc}+) to hide what you do; a miss, or a hit with Despair, costs extra Sanity, and a miss gives you away to them and the GMs.
after.other: {n} other people in this room can see you. Unless you Move the Body, you first roll Shadow ({dc}+) to hide what you do; a miss, or a hit with Despair, costs extra Sanity, and a miss gives you away to them and the GMs.

before.one: {n} inna osoba jest w tym pokoju. Najpierw maskujesz, co robisz ({dc}+), a przyłapanie kosztuje Sanity.
before.few: {n} inne osoby są w tym pokoju. Najpierw maskujesz, co robisz ({dc}+), a przyłapanie kosztuje Sanity.
before.many: {n} innych osób jest w tym pokoju. Najpierw maskujesz, co robisz ({dc}+), a przyłapanie kosztuje Sanity.
before.other: {n} innych osób jest w tym pokoju. Najpierw maskujesz, co robisz ({dc}+), a przyłapanie kosztuje Sanity.

after.one: W tym pokoju jest {n} inna osoba. Poza przenoszeniem ciała najpierw rzucasz Shadow ({dc}+), żeby ukryć, co robisz. Trafienie z Despair i pudło kosztują dodatkowo Sanity, a pudło zdradza cię obecnym i GM-om.
after.few: W tym pokoju są {n} inne osoby. Poza przenoszeniem ciała najpierw rzucasz Shadow ({dc}+), żeby ukryć, co robisz. Trafienie z Despair i pudło kosztują dodatkowo Sanity, a pudło zdradza cię obecnym i GM-om.
after.many: W tym pokoju jest {n} innych osób. Poza przenoszeniem ciała najpierw rzucasz Shadow ({dc}+), żeby ukryć, co robisz. Trafienie z Despair i pudło kosztują dodatkowo Sanity, a pudło zdradza cię obecnym i GM-om.
after.other: W tym pokoju jest {n} innych osób. Poza przenoszeniem ciała najpierw rzucasz Shadow ({dc}+), żeby ukryć, co robisz. Trafienie z Despair i pudło kosztują dodatkowo Sanity, a pudło zdradza cię obecnym i GM-om.

removed: "being caught at it costs Sanity" now names when: a miss, and a hit with Despair.
disagreements: The owner's pilot pair 40 said only a miss with Despair costs Sanity and had no {dc}; the current text has {dc}, and concealFromWitnesses also charges a miss with Hope and a hit with Despair, so the pilot after is not used word for word.
